items.proposed: keep coder A row: other (HER2-negative), enrichment, candidate_matched false, arm Part 2B
items.reason: Part 2B requires 'unresectable or metastatic HER2 negative esophageal, gastroesophageal (GEJ), or gastric adenocarcinoma', a tumour molecular requirement for one cohort, so it is an enrichment biomarker under §5. It is not linked to M3T01 (anti-FasL). It does not change any trial outcome: any_molecular_selection is already true from the MGMT-unmethylated Part 2A requirement, and candidate_matched_selection stays false.

The Part 2A glioblastoma cohort excludes 'Subjects with IDH-1 or IDH-2 mutations or H3 K27M diffuse midline glioma' and 'recurrent or secondary GBM', which is an IDH-wildtype requirement for glioblastoma, so cns5 under §1.1.
Same drug; the record says 'leucovorin 400 mg/m2', but manual §3 requires INN spelling, and the INN is folinic acid (both coders already used folinic acid as the agent moiety).

RP2D 'will be determined based upon available pharmacokinetic, pharmacodynamic, and preliminary clinical efficacy data' (a stated PD objective for M3T01), and the trial requires pre-treatment tumour tissue plus 'a tumor accessible for biopsy while on treatment', i.e. paired tumour sampling. Under W7, a stated PD objective with paired tumour sampling = yes. No specific PD marker is named, and GBM patients 'will not undergo a protocol specified biopsy', so this is not certain.

note: any_molecular_selection true from MGMT-unmethylated enrichment (Part 2A arm label) and HER2-negative enrichment (Part 2B); IDH/H3K27M rows define GBM and are excluded from that outcome. Pembrolizumab is soc_backbone as agreed ('given as standard of care'), although in Part 1B it is the escalation combination partner. Priority-3 arm-label and regimen_id differences not addressed.
